chart.title: Net electricity imports
chart.subtitle: Net electricity imports are calculated as electricity imports minus exports. Countries with positive values are net importers of electricity; negative values are net exporters. Measured in [terawatt-hours](#dod:watt-hours).

Net imports - TWh.descriptionShort: Electricity imports minus exports, measured in [terawatt-hours](#dod:watt-hours).
